name: odd-fish
description: A square neo-brutalist profile plate: striped header, hard offset shadow, three counts, and a full-width follow.
purpose: Keeps the inspo card square and hatched instead of flattening it to the control radius, while mapping ink and fill to semantic tokens.
bestFor: catalogue cards that need a hard frame
compact identity blocks beside other atoms
avoidFor: dense data that needs a plain table
